name: Dante completes the Divine Comedy
summary: Dante Alighieri completes the Paradiso, the third canticle of the Commedia, in his Ravenna exile shortly before his death (1321). The 100-canto vernacular epic in Tuscan terza rima establishes Italian as a literary language and provides medieval Christendom with its most ambitious literary synthesis of theology, philosophy, and politics.

_quarry.structural_significance: Canonical literary work of the Latin Middle Ages; first major use of Italian vernacular for high literary purposes, decisive for the later development of European national literatures.
